name: Soulrot
description:
Damage dealt by Deathchaser now applies Soulrot.

Rot the soul of your target, cursing them for 30 seconds. At the end of the duration the enemy will take damage based on the number of stacks accrued.

Each instance of damage from Deathchaser adds 1 stack to this effect, up to 20 stacks. Dispelling this effect causes the dispeller to instantly take 1200 + 200% SP Shadow Damage.
